text:
I’m sorry you’re feeling this way. I think it’s completely fair to talk about how the process and the system make people feel without turning it into a political fight.

I’m Israeli and my partner is Filipino, so I can understand why this subject can feel very personal and exhausting. And I don’t think someone else having a positive experience means your experience or feelings are any less valid.

I hope today gets a little better for you ❤️
